title: Q17
description:
“A merciful and faithful High Priest in things pertaining to God, to make propitiation for the sins of the people.”
Read: Exo 28:1, 29–30, Lev 16:15–16, 30
a) On the Day of Atonement the high priest acts *toward God* for the people, to deal with their sins. What does Lev 16 bring forward into this first mention of the Son as High Priest?
b) Lev 16 shows the high priest bearing the people's names before Yahweh. What does that add to “merciful and faithful”?
